verdict.rationale: Turso documents agent-driven provisioning through every channel in the story. The Platform API lets you create, token-scope, and tear down databases, groups, and tokens (turso-docs-8, turso-docs-60). The CLI covers `turso db create` and `turso db shell` (turso-docs-14, turso-docs-40, turso-docs-50). An official MCP server lets an agent manage databases and run SQL with no token copying (turso-docs-9, turso-docs-37). Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of fetching the database URL/connection string programmatically; schema application is only implied through SQL execution; no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404); no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the full flow.
